description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Take one import back: rows it created are removed and metrics it filled on synced rows are cleared. Synced data is never touched. Confirm with the user first.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/imports/files/{id}/undo.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

name: ads_import_undo
title: Undo a stats file import
